share_price_recent.notes: Bearer (UHR) +2.77% on the day; registered (UHRN) +3.21% on the day. Registered share is priced at ~1/5 of bearer, reflecting 5:1 ratio.

market_cap_notes: ~CHF 10.63B as of May 2026 per stockanalysis.com and simplywall.st. Enterprise value ~CHF 11B (alphaspread.com).

shares_outstanding_m.notes: Approximate. Annual report 2024 states ~51.5M bearer shares and ~147M registered shares (5:1 price ratio, 1:1 voting). Total economic shares ~199M on a bearer-equivalent basis approx.

valuation_multiples.pe_trailing: ~3500x (distorted — TTM net income CHF 3M from FY2025; not meaningful for analysis)
valuation_multiples.pe_forward_notes: Based on consensus FY2025 EPS estimates (stockanalysis.com, disfold.com)
valuation_multiples.ev_ebitda_notes: LTM per multiples.vc (May 2026). AlphaSpread reports 16.7x. valueinvesting.io reports 17.53x. Range 14-17x depending on source and date.
valuation_multiples.dividend_yield_notes: Based on CHF 4.50 bearer dividend / ~CHF 210 price (May 2026). Some sources show 2.14-2.28%.
valuation_multiples.ev_sales_notes: LTM per multiples.vc. Also reported as 1.74x (price/sales) by investing.com.

dividend_history.notes: Dividends shown by fiscal year (paid in May of the following year). Bearer shares receive 5x the registered share dividend.
dividend_history.source: divvydiary.com (CH0012255151) and dividendmax.com; confirmed via swatchgroup.com press releases

share_price_history_eoy.notes: Year-end closing prices (last trading day of December). Direct year-end prices were not available from open web sources; estimates derived from market cap data (stockanalysis.com) divided by approximate shares outstanding, cross-referenced with annual PE ratios (companiesmarketcap.com) and EPS data.

2024.basis: Market cap CHF 8.46B / ~52M bearer shares. Consistent with 52-week low of ~CHF 127 in early 2025 and watchpro.com reporting 16-year lows around CHF 141. The stock was under pressure through 2024 on weak China demand.

2023.basis: Market cap CHF 11.66B / ~52M shares. PE of 13.8x × FY2023 EPS CHF 16.76 = ~CHF 231. Both methods consistent.

2022.basis: Market cap CHF 13.10B / ~52M shares. PE 18.4x × FY2022 EPS CHF 15.57 = ~CHF 286. Range CHF 250-286; market cap method used as primary.

2021.basis: Market cap CHF 14.18B / ~52M shares. PE 19.8x × FY2021 EPS CHF 14.77 = ~CHF 292.

2020.basis: Market cap data for 2020 not available from open sources. FY2020 EPS was approximately CHF 3.11 (year of Covid); PE was negative in 2020 per companiesmarketcap.com (net loss year). Price estimated around CHF 240-270 based on recovery trajectory.

2019.basis: Not retrievable from open web sources without paywalled historical data. FY2019 PE was 20.3x per companiesmarketcap.com. FY2019 EPS not confirmed from open sources.

analyst_consensus.notes: Data as of May 2026 from multiple sources (investing.com, simplywall.st). Note: Stock has significantly rallied (up ~47-51% over 12 months) vs. average analyst target, suggesting consensus may lag recent re-rating. Recent upgrades: Citi raised to CHF 193 (Neutral), BofA upgraded to Neutral CHF 200, RBC upgraded to Sector Perform CHF 220.

performance_vs_smi.notes: Significant underperformance vs SMI and luxury peers over 2022-2024 period. Strong recovery from late 2024/early 2025 lows.

major_shareholders.control_mechanism: Dual-class shares: registered shares (CHF 0.45 nominal) carry same vote as bearer (CHF 2.25 nominal) but are 1/5 the price. Family concentrates in registered shares to amplify voting power vs economic stake.
major_shareholders.activist_interest: 2024/2025: An activist investor sought a board seat challenging Hayek family control (reported by Hedgeweek and Business of Fashion).
major_shareholders.source: whoistheownerof.com; DCF modeling.com; swatchgroup.com Annual Report 2025 corporate governance; swissinfo.ch (Hayek family share purchases July 2024)

short_interest.notes: Short interest data for SIX-listed UHR shares (Swiss exchange) is not publicly disclosed in standard open-web sources. ORTEX and similar platforms track it behind paywalls. OTC equivalents (SWGAF, SWGNF) may have US-reported short interest but are low-volume proxies. Could not retrieve a reliable figure.

key_financial_context_2024.eps_note: FY2024 EPS CHF 3.73 per bearer share (vs CHF 16.76 in FY2023). FY2025 EPS collapsed to CHF 0.06 due to tax spike.
